summary.text: David Martin is a Republican member of the South Carolina House of Representatives who represents District 26, having assumed office on November 11, 2024, and is seeking re-election in the general election on November 3, 2026.
He advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026, and is a lawyer.

paragraphs.text: Martin was born in Fort Mill, South Carolina, and earned a bachelor's degree from Coastal Carolina University and a law degree from the Charlotte School of Law.
His career experience, according to Ballotpedia, includes working as a lawyer.
He succeeded R. Raye Felder in the seat and is assigned to the House Judiciary Committee in the 2025-2026 session.
